author: Ari Koslow
title: Buddy Kennedy traded to Mariners
desc: The Mariners acquired INF Buddy Kennedy from the  Giants in exchange for cash considerations.
impact: Kennedy was designated for assignment by San Francisco. He'll add infield depth for the Mariners.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Sogard (oblique) to begin rehab assignment in coming days
desc: Nick Sogard is expected to begin a minor league rehab assignment in the coming days.
impact: Sogard has been sidelined since May 31 due to a right oblique strain. He has been completing defensive and hitting work and appears on track to begin a rehab assignment in the coming days.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Patrick Sandoval (biceps) throws 60 pitches in rehab start Sunday
desc: Patrick Sandoval allowed one run on three hits and a walk while striking out three over four innings in Sunday's rehab start with Triple-A Worcester.
impact: Sandoval has yet to make his Boston Red Sox debut as he continues to recover from internal brace surgery and a biceps injury suffered during spring training. He has posted a 4.34 ERA and 1.45 WHIP across seven rehab appearances and is expected to make one more start before being considered for activation.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jameson Taillon (hamstring) to throw live BP Tuesday
desc: Jameson Taillon is scheduled to throw a live batting practice session on Tuesday
impact: Taillon has been sidelined since June 8 with a left hamstring strain. He threw a successful bullpen session on Friday and will now face live hitters on Tuesday. Chicago Cubs manager Craig Counsell has not ruled out Taillon returning to the rotation before the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Graham Ashcraft (elbow) set for follow-up MRI Tuesday
desc: Graham Ashcraft is scheduled to get a follow-up MRI on Tuesday.
impact: Ashcraft continues to recover from a right UCL sprain that landed him on the 60-day injured list May 29. He received a PRP injection June 2 and is set to undergo a follow-up MRI. If results are encouraging, he will likely begin a throwing program.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ke'Bryan Hayes (back) to take live BP Wednesday and Thursday
desc: Ke'Bryan Hayes is scheduled to take live batting practice on Wednesday and Thursday.
impact: Hayes has been sidelined since May 22 with a lumbar bulging disc. He is set to test his back in live batting practice on back-to-back days. If he responds well after both sessions, a minor league rehab assignment is likely to follow.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Brandon Williamson (shoulder) pauses throwing program
desc: Brandon Williamson has paused his throwing program after suffering a finger injury during a workout.
impact: Williamson has been sidelined since April 30 due to left shoulder fatigue. While he had progressed to a throwing program, it was temporarily paused after he sustained a finger injury during a workout. It remains unclear when he will resume throwing.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Angel Martinez (foot) playing catch and hitting off tee
desc: Angel Martinez has begun playing catch and hitting off a tee.
impact: Martinez suffered a non-displaced fracture in his left foot on June 13. While he has begun baseball activities, he is still not expected to be activated from the injured list until late July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Pete Crow-Armstrong swipes two bags Sunday
desc: Pete Crow-Armstrong went 0-for-2 with three walks, one run scored and two stolen bases in Sunday's 4-3 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers.
impact: While Crow-Armstrong did not record a hit for the second consecutive game, he still made an impact by drawing three walks and stealing two bases. He has been one of the top hitters in June, slashing .367/.447/.765 with 10 home runs and eight stolen bases.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ben Williamson hits solo homer Sunday
desc: Ben Williamson went 1-for-4 with a solo home run in Sunday's 5-1 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks.
impact: Williamson drew the start at second base on Sunday and took advantage of the opportunity, launching a 402-foot home run off Merrill Kelly to left-center field in the sixth inning. He has struggled this season, hitting .236 with a .635 OPS and two home runs across 174 at-bats.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cedric Mullins II launches homer Sunday
desc: Cedric Mullins II went 1-for-4 with a solo home run in Sunday's 5-1 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks.
impact: Mullins hit his second home run in his last three games and has driven in a run in each contest during that span. He has been productive for the Tampa Bay Rays in June, slashing .261/.350/.478 with five home runs and three stolen bases.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Victor Mesa Jr. swipes bag Sunday
desc: Victor Mesa Jr. went 1-for-4 with a stolen base in Sunday's 5-1 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks.
impact: Mesa finished the weekend 3-for-11 with a double, a run scored and a stolen base. He has started in four of the Tampa Bay Rays' last five games, but remains off the fantasy radar as he is slashing .178/.302/.333 in 45 at-bats in June.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Drew Rasmussen tosses six scoreless innings Sunday
desc: Drew Rasmussen tossed six scoreless innings in Sunday's 5-1 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks, allowing three hits and one walk while striking out five.
impact: Rasmussen was dominant once again on Sunday, allowing just three hits while recording his fifth consecutive quality start. He wrapped up an outstanding June with a 0.82 ERA, 0.61 WHIP and 39 strikeouts across 33 innings. Rasmussen is scheduled to make his next start on Saturday against the Houston Astros.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Junior Caminero stays hot with homer Sunday
desc: Junior Caminero went 3-for-3 with a home run, one walk, one run scored and two RBI in Sunday's 5-1 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks.
impact: Caminero crushed a 463-foot home run off Merrill Kelly in the fifth inning, extending his home run streak to four games. He has been one of the hottest hitters in baseball, leading the majors with seven home runs while ranking second with a 1.731 OPS over his last seven games.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Liam Hicks (back) swinging without limitations
desc: Liam Hicks is swinging without limitations and able to play catch.
impact: Hicks participated in a full day of baseball activities on Friday and is swinging the bat without any limitations. Given his steady progress, he has a chance to be activated from the injured list when he first becomes eligible on June 30.
